{

  onClose,

  index,
  total
}

[
            {n: project.features.length, l: "Features"},
            {n: project.tech.length, l: "Tech Stack"},
            {n: project.contribution.length, l: "Contributions"},
          ].map
[{key: idRef.current++, name: booth.name, zone: booth.zone, status: next, who, time: nowStr()}, ...prev].slice

functions.name: DemoFrame
params:
{
  theme,
  label,
  tag,
  controls,
  footer,
  children,
}

callGraph.callee:
[
    demo.live ? {icon: "🔗", label: "라이브 데모", href: demo.live} : null,
    demo.video ? {icon: "▶", label: "풀 영상", href: demo.video} : null,
    demo.repo ? {icon: "⌥", label: "GitHub 저장소", href: demo.repo} : null,
  ].filter
chars.map((c, i) => (!scrambleable(c) || i < p ? c : SCRAMBLE[Math.floor(Math.random() * SCRAMBLE.length)])).join
([["Keep", theme.primary, data.kpt.keep], ["Problem", "#f87171", data.kpt.problem], ["Try", "#fbbf24", data.kpt.try]] as const).map
